$comment: Single authority for per-package coverage floors. Each runner config (vitest coverage.thresholds / jest coverageThreshold) enforces these, and scripts/docs-claims-check.mjs derives the coverage-floor-* and coverage-vs-target doc markers from this file. Floors ratchet from measured values (measured via `pnpm run test:coverage`); the 80%-lines target is declared in `target`, not enforced here.
